notes: Modified cash basis school district; all funds governmental (School Nutrition is a nonmajor governmental fund). Receipts/disbursements from the governmental funds statement (pp4-5 of trimmed PDF), Total Governmental Funds column. Beginning/ending cash = total fund balance 13,018,984 / 14,793,255 (p5); roll-forward 13,018,984 + 13,094,264 - 11,319,993 = 14,793,255. Transfers net to zero in the total column (reclassification column eliminates 76,853 transfers and interfund loan 250,000) so transfers_in/out are null. Printed total receipts is 1 above the sum of printed lines (rounding); recorded in report_discrepancies. 'Other local receipts' split into activity receipts 376,744 (nonmajor, p9) and 5,852 (General Fund, p4); 'Other nonrevenue receipts' split into sale of property 6,372 and other 6,477 (General Fund, p12). Balance sheet uses the government-wide-style Statement of Activities and Net Position (p6); no liabilities printed. Detail: General Fund recorded from the budget-and-actual schedule (pp11-13) rather than the General Fund components combining schedule (pp7-8), and individual fund budget-and-actual schedules (pp14-22) used instead of the nonmajor combining schedule (pp9-10), to avoid double counting. General Fund schedule disbursements include 8000 Transfers 76,853 (recorded as other financing -76,853) and receipts include interfund loan 250,000 (other financing); printed totals include them. Depreciation Fund and Student Fee have no printed totals so no detail_totals. Read pages 1-22 of 22 Balance sheet (user 2026-10-27): governmental lines from the governmental funds statement of assets, liabilities and fund balances (p6), Total Governmental Funds column.
